shapes.title: One Long Thread — Dye corners an inner edge or the central patch
shapes.help: Corners, inner edge and central patch ignore where you tap. Corners changes four stitches; inner edge changes forty-four; central patch changes forty-eight. Everything outside the chosen shape keeps its dye. Undo restores the whole decision.
shapes.message: shapes choices preserve physical dye membership one-edit history and loose-yarn locks

half-shifts.title: One Long Thread — Exchange the two halves by wrapping the picture
half-shifts.help: Move halfway across twelve columns, halfway across sixteen rows, or both. The moved picture wraps; no dye is copied or lost. Each move exchanges two equal halves, so doing it twice restores the picture. Undo remains one edit.
half-shifts.message: half-shifts choices preserve physical dye membership one-edit history and loose-yarn locks

regional-dyes.title: One Long Thread — Cycle the dye in one half and leave the other alone
regional-dyes.help: Cycle only the chosen physical half through Cream, Rust, Coral and Moss. The other half stays unchanged. Four cycles restore the dyes; the picture still becomes your own edited picture. Undo restores each single cycle.
regional-dyes.message: regional-dyes choices preserve physical dye membership one-edit history and loose-yarn locks

stripe-phases.title: One Long Thread — Dye every third physical row or column from a tapped stitch
stripe-phases.help: Tap to choose one of three stripe positions. Every third row keeps rows with the same row remainder; every third column does the same for columns. Both stripes dyes their union, with crossing stitches counted once. These are physical stripes, not every third section of the strand.
stripe-phases.message: stripe-phases choices preserve physical dye membership one-edit history and loose-yarn locks

motifs.title: One Long Thread — Start a house waves or a diamond before pulling its yarn
motifs.help: House, Waves and Diamond are small authored dye plans on the same cloth. Choosing one starts full cloth and clears dye history, just like the older pictures. Keeping a picture saves its dye plan, not its loose-yarn progress.
motifs.message: motifs choices preserve physical dye membership one-edit history and loose-yarn locks
